title: Credit a `dotnet test --no-build` run when it follows a recognised `dotnet build` on the same unchanged source basis (build-then-test gate shape)
outcome: A repository whose gate is "build, then `dotnet test --no-build` with no source movement between" earns host test credit for that pair. The --no-build test is credited only when a recognised build of the same configuration completed on the same content revision and nothing changed between them. Otherwise it stays uncredited, as DD1 rules for w-8e72f7e16778.
acceptance: Credit a `dotnet test --no-build` run when it follows a recognised `dotnet build` on the same unchanged source basis (build-then-test gate shape) is done
